allow-images.description: Render Markdown images that pass the URL policy. Otherwise show their alternative text.

heading-offset.description: Add zero through five levels to source headings. The output stops at level six. Invalid values use two.

src-text.description: Markdown source. A supplied value, including an empty string, takes precedence over the default text slot.

streaming.description: Keep established blocks mounted while an answer grows. Turn it off when the source is complete.

--ki-corner-inline.description: Small radius for an outline around inline content.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-layout-spacing-5xl.description: The 5xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xs.description: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-markdown-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter for the answer surface.

--ki-markdown-bg.description: Answer surface backing. It defaults to transparent so the enclosing surface shows through.

--ki-markdown-bg-image.description: Optional image over the answer's solid backing.

--ki-markdown-block-gap.description: Spacing between Markdown blocks at standard density.

--ki-markdown-inline-code-backdrop-filte.description: Complete backdrop filter for inline code.

--ki-markdown-inline-code-bg.description: Solid backing of an inline code span.

--ki-markdown-inline-code-bg-image.description: Optional image over the inline code backing.

--ki-markdown-inline-code-fg.description: Ink for source within an inline code span.

--ki-markdown-muted-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter for quotes and table headings.

--ki-markdown-muted-bg.description: Backing of quotes and table headings.

--ki-markdown-muted-bg-image.description: Optional image over the muted backing.

--ki-markdown-muted-fg.description: Ink for quotes and table headings, strengthened under more contrast.

--ki-markdown-quote-border.description: Logical start rule of a quotation and the ink of a thematic divider.

--ki-outline-low-em.description: semantic color for outline low em.

--ki-spacing-action-hairline.description: Width of the frame and divider in an action surface.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-family-mono.description: semantic font family for typography family mono.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 2.

--ki-typography-line-height-heading-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height heading 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-heading-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height heading 2.

--ki-typography-line-height-title-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height title 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-title-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height title 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-heading-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size heading 1.

--ki-typography-size-heading-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size heading 2.

--ki-typography-size-title-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size title 1.

--ki-typography-size-title-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size title 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

component.description: Displays Markdown as Kimen components and native HTML semantics.

allowImages.description: Render Markdown images that pass the URL policy. Otherwise show their alternative text.

headingOffset.description: Add zero through five levels to source headings. The output stops at level six. Invalid values use two.

srcText.description: Markdown source. A supplied value, including an empty string, takes precedence over the default text slot.

streaming.description: Keep established blocks mounted while an answer grows. Turn it off when the source is complete.

slots.description: Literal Markdown source. Set a text node or escape markup when writing HTML.
